narr: Scattered thunderstorms in advance of a frontal boundary produced heavy rain which caused flash flooding across portions of southeast Virginia.
ev: Flash flooding was reported around Patrick Henry Mall in Newport News, including on Jefferson Avenue and Old Oyster Point Road.
Road flooding was reported. Road was closed due to flash flooding. Vehicles were stranded.
High water was reported on Denbigh Boulevard in Newport News.
There were several reports of street flooding in flood prone areas.
Car was reported in high water near the 2600 Block of Desert Road.
Flash flooding was reported at the intersection of Indian River Road and Lynnhaven Parkway. This area was impassable due to high water earlier in the day.
